headline: President Biden set the order of officials who would lead the Justice Department if top leaders cannot serve.
what_it_does: This order lists which Justice Department officials would step in to act as Attorney General if the Attorney General and other top leaders are unable to do the job. It is about who is in charge during vacancies or absences. No summary was provided, so details such as the exact positions listed are not described here.

who_it_affects.how: It sets which officials would temporarily take over the Attorney General's duties, and in what order, if higher-ranking leaders are unavailable.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed January 3, 2025; the specific effective date was not provided.
